quest.title: The First Experiment: Elements
quest.description: After finding Albedo, Rosaria leaves on her own. You chat with Albedo and discover the objective of his research: to use alchemy to cause a seed from another world to sprout and flourish. To better understand otherworldly lifeforms, Albedo states his desire to observe you and to perform some experiments in the process.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x375, Mora x22000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x5

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon has a question. After the seed sprouts, will it grow into anything?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I don't know, but I feel the importance will lie in the method, not the end point.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Using alchemy to awaken otherworldy life in Teyvat would constitute a big leap in my understanding of the essence of life.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: After awakening, even creation may be possible.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Aha... Still a little difficult to understand?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: N—No! Paimon's got a brain! But what's the seed gonna become? Isn't that more interesting than whatever it was you were saying?

choices.text: Doesn't seem like you understood.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Well, if it turns out to be a delicious fruit, dinner's on me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yay! Paimon's holding you to it!

choices.text: You sure know how to keep Paimon on board.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Well, let's just say I... occasionally have to look after a child. Another lengthy explanation I'm afraid. I suppose it's one of the few non-alchemy-related disciplines I'm any good at.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: The subject of my first research was the elements. In this world, manipulating the elements requires a Vision, though I can't see anything resembling one on your person.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: How you're able to freely manipulate elemental power is something I'd like to ascertain. I've got a few questions in that regard.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Firstly, do you have any extra organs? A second heart, a fourth stomach... things of that nature.

choices.text: No.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Fascinating. And this floating child is... connected to your body in some way?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What a stupid question! Can't you see the gap between us?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And another thing, it's PAIMON! Not "floating child"!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I was merely considering the possibility that you were an external organ. Perhaps there is some invisible force connecting you.

choices.text: I met Paimon on my travels.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Oh, that rules out that possibility. I wonder, did Paimon guide the elemental power to you?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: But that would mean that Paimon's elemental power would be enough to break through mountain rock at least ten meters thick. Or cause the waterfall south of Springvale to flow backwards.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Hmm. No, that definitely can't be it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! How would you know anyway!?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: In that case, it would appear that there's no obvious difference between the composition of your body, and that of the humans in this world.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Given that there's clearly a discrepancy in the research, it seems that only experimentation will yield the answers.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Firstly, this mysterious elemental power. I'd like to examine exactly how it manifests externally.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Let me lure a few slimes to the area. Perhaps you'd be able to defeat them, using whatever method comes most naturally to you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Doesn't seem very sciencey...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Direct and clear observation are imperative to a good experiment. This is just a simple exercise.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Naturally, if you require a greater challenge, we could bring in six oceanids.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Slimes! Slimes are fine!

choices.text: I don't follow. This seems like a hassle.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Well, prepare yourself. The slimes will be here any moment.

choices.text: As long as I'm not being batted around by Hydro mimics.
I caught Paimon with a fishing rod.
Not that I'm aware of.
You've seen through Paimon's ulterior motives.
That's what I want to know.

talks.objective: Defeat the slimes to complete the experiment
Talk to Albedo and hear his conclusions

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Great work. Did you feel anything out of the ordinary?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: If you're injured, I have a few emergency potions ready.

choices.text: Not a scratch.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Excellent. According to my observations, the manifestation of the external elemental flow is as expected, elemental reactions are normal. There's nothing out of the ordinary.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Now that we know that the external flow is manifesting normally, let's test the internal flow.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Internal flow... How do you test that?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: It's very simple. I can use alchemy to create a potion that will extract elemental power.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: If the elemental power is stored or accumulated physically within your body, this potion may elicit an elemental reaction.

choices.text: Will it make my stomach Swirl?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds kinda terrifying!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Don't worry, in the normal course of events you'd feel some temporary queasiness, no bodily injury.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And in the abnormal course of events?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: If anything unexpected occurs, I've made the necessary preparations. Try not to worry.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's not hugely reassuring...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Well, it's not that there aren't any risks involved. But if there is anything blocking your elemental flow, we'll be able to locate it with this test.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Just a warning: if an internal elemental reaction occurs for any other reason, that's a bad sign.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: This is like a health checkup.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Yes! That's an excellent way to think about it. Before we get started, the potion we'll use for the test is missing a catalyst. We'll need to find it.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: It's a type of ore known as Starsilver, but unfortunately not all of it is suitable.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I'll take you to my campsite. We can gather some Starsilver Ore on the way. I'll point out any likely contenders.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: All going to plan, we should be able to begin concocting the potion when we get to the campsite.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's still got a few safety concerns, but seems like there's a silver lining.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's keep our eyes open!

choices.text: Will it Crystallize in my stomach?
Just a bit cold.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: An elemental life form from another world! As soon as we have strong evidence, this may end up subverting a lot of alchemical theories.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Albedo's research will see huge progress!

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Doesn't sound very rigorous, surely there's another approach...

talks.objective: Follow the road and search for a Starsilver Catalyst

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: This is my campsite. I've added the materials we collected to the concoction.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: While we are waiting, have a look over here.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: My assistant Timaeus here is helping me with my research. I'm guessing you may have met in Mondstadt already?

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Hello, I've just gotten hold of the data from your experiment. The report is already up on the board there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Look at all the data! You got all these results from one slime battle?

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Haha, I wouldn't call them results. Inferences, and a few daring guesses perhaps.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: I think the most rational direction would be to expound on the phylogenetic relationship between this Traveler and the slimes.

choices.text: Rational?

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: Hmm, consider: You don't have a Vision, but you can manipulate elemental energy. The slimes don't have Visions either, yet they, too, are able to manipulate the elements.

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: Following this line of thought, I'm sure we'll be able to establish a basis in fact.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Not bad for a point of entry, but strictly speaking, slimes are elemental life forms. In other words, beings consisting entirely of the elements.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: A Cryo Regisvine, or even a Whopperflower might be a better analogy. But tracing back the phylogenetic relationships between plants and animals... You might have to trace back to the world's origins.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: In that sense, things might get difficult, don't you think?

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: Uh! Yes sir. That sounds correct.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: After all, we've got our primary data already. This Traveler is a visitor from another world.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: #If it turned out that {M#he}{F#she} did have a phylogenetic relationship with this world... Now that really would be something, wouldn't it?

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: Ahhhh, it would! Apologies, I was so excited to get the data. I'll slow down a bit next time.

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: Speaking of data — to complete our research, we'll need some more. I'll be conducting analysis here for the time being. If you're keen for an update, just come and find me!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Great, I'll leave you to it.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Hmm, looks like the potion's ready. I'll try a little first. If all goes well, I'll hand it over to you.

choices.text: I would've thought even Paimon and I were more closely related.

talks.objective: Take the potion from the desk

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I've just tried some, it's in line with my expectations.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Remember to keep calm at all times, and breathe deeply if you feel unwell.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I'll be noting down all observable results and data points.

talks.objective: Talk to Albedo and hear his conclusions

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Tasty? You've got a funny look on your face, {NICKNAME}!

choices.text: It's... burning a bit.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #You said you tried some already! You sure it was ready? What happened to {M#him}{F#her}?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Hmm? Oh, this was the result I was expecting, and a very positive one at that.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: This potion channels elemental power into the body. Under normal circumstances, a repelling reaction is to be expected.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: But if the internal elemental flow is unimpeded, you'll only experience momentary discomfort. Once the flow is complete, there won't be any other effects.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you knew you'd be sick and still drank some?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Eh-he, it was my own concoction of course, only natural for me to be the guinea pig.

choices.text: Out of... consideration for the test subject?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: But of course! You're my assistant, by all sense and reason it would be wrong of me to place that risk onto you.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: In conclusion, I'd say we have our conclusion! As far as elemental energy is concerned, you're no different from anyone else in this world, nothing peculiar.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aw, Paimon wanted something cooler to happen...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Then again, better an ordinary result than a peculiar result. Peculiar results have a tendency to be of the... undesirable variety.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I feel like you're referring to something in particular...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: The good thing about "ordinary" is that everything is an object of reference, and everyone understands you.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: People are the same, they can understand, empathize, encourage, and support one another.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: When you're sick, a doctor can diagnose you because they are you. When something goes wrong, you can ask people who've made the same mistake for their experience, because you are them.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: But a peculiar person... They don't have much recourse for the things we take for granted. The essence of their life is fundamentally different.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: For example... A human can't understand the life of a Pyro Regisvine, or an Eye of the Storm. Have I explained it clearly enough?

choices.text: I think I'm getting it.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: To sum up, this has been a positive outcome. Going forward, you can use your elemental power without fear.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Timaeus, the results of the new experiment are out. If you could see to collating them...

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: Just a moment, Sir! I'll handle it!

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: You gave me a lot to consider, really stretched my limits. I'm thinking a lot clearer now.

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: Having you down as an animal wasn't very precise of me, but starting with the premise of an elemental life form!? Now that was—

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Not bad, I think it's an interesting line of inquiry. Whatever the truth of the matter, I'd like your research at the fore as opposed to my judgment.

response.speaker: Timaeus
response.text: You can count on me, Sir! I'll extract a result satisfactory to all!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is he trying to join the Knights? He's starting to sound like a suck-up...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... What Paimon meant to say was... That's the spirit! Mr. Albedo, say something...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Hmm... Before we can proceed with our research, I need to... prepare something. Wait one moment.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: If you're interested, why not have a look around? It may help to pass the time.

choices.text: Still seems... like there's another layer of meaning to your words.
What about the risk to you!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Perhaps it's just scholarly self-assurance, and it certainly speeds things up.

choices.text: You drank this!?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm, in line with my expectations. Ready to drink.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Remember to keep calm at all times, and breathe deeply if you feel unwell.
